neighbours.label: word pieces ending in 'h' that the next piece must complete with a vowel: ' appreh' (apprehension, apprehended) and the '-h' of left-/right-hander
fire: There was a sense of apprehension in the room before the verdict was read.
He looked at the narrow bridge with obvious apprehension.
Officers apprehended two men who were fleeing across the parking lot.
She was apprehensive about meeting her new boss for the first time.
The team traded for a young right-hander with a hard fastball.
The tall left-hander gave up only two hits in seven innings.
Scouts say the right-hander could be ready for the majors by June.
The manager sent in a left-hander to face the final batter.
quiet: There was a sense of nervousness in the room before the verdict was read.
He looked at the narrow bridge with obvious fear.
Officers arrested two men who were fleeing across the parking lot.
She was anxious about meeting her new boss for the first time.
The team traded for a young pitcher with a hard fastball.
The tall reliever gave up only two hits in seven innings.
Scouts say the right-handed starter could be ready for the majors by June.
The manager sent in a fresh arm to face the final batter.

notes: Card: '-h' x6 (right-hander), ' appreh' x4, ' compreh' x2, ' Happ' x2; output promotes 'ens', ' enth'. Probes: apprehension 0.56, left-hander 0.41, apprehended 0.32; whole-token ' comprehensive' 0.01, ' happily' 0.10, right-handed 0.03.
